changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and clarified the human evaluation guidelines to be more structured and comprehensive. Added the third-party evaluation method.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on interactive NLG with rewriting/infilling capabilities for creative image captioning. It uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, n-gram diversity, perplexity) and extensive human evaluations (Likert scales, pairwise comparisons). The metadata extraction was generally accurate but needed some refinement for specificity and normalization.
